purpose: Explicit gaps, rejections, and nulls for the Chainlink oracle-boundary pack. Missing, conflicting, stale, and uncheckable evidence stays visible; nothing here is averaged away or silently dropped.

gaps.detail: HTTP 404 at collection time. Proof-of-reserves documentation drifted or moved; no PoR content was frozen. Every PoR-dependent claim is null in this pack. A future 200 is a correction event, not retroactive evidence.

HTTP 429 (rate limited) on anonymous readback at collection time. The feed UI's presented heartbeat/deviation values could not be frozen; the docs registry excerpt is the issuer source of record for those fields.

DNS/connection failure from the collection seat at collection time. Incident and correction history is therefore UNMEASURED in this pack; no claim about Chainlink's incident handling is made in either direction.
No publisher or node signatures are exposed at the consumer read path. Whether per-node signed submissions exist and verify is out of scope for this intake; vector NEG-05/NEG-06 cover the boundary.

gaps.surface: aggregator contract config (threshold/heartbeat as on-chain values)
gaps.detail: The declared threshold (0.5%) and heartbeat (3600s) come from the issuer registry page; the standard consumer read path does not expose them as contract state. Checkable only indirectly via update cadence.

gaps.surface: aggregator proxy admin / multisig / timelock state
gaps.detail: Who can upgrade or reconfigure the feed contracts was not probed in this intake. No governance claim is made; this is a required input for any future provenance-controls run.

Cross-RPC replay executed (chainlink-cross-rpc-replay.json): publicnode and drpc serve the identical block hash at pinned block 26015635 and byte-identical description/decimals/latestRoundData results; cloudflare-eth.com cannot fulfill eth_blockNumber (deprecated gateway) and its failure is preserved in the report. Residual limitation: both replays ran from one physical seat; a second-seat replay remains open and is recorded in the report itself.

rejections.rejected: ETH or LINK price level, market performance, or feed 'accuracy' against venue prices
rejections.reason: Asset performance is not governance quality; price truth is outside what oracle-boundary evidence establishes (boundary axiom 1).

rejections.rejected: CoinMarketCap / CoinGecko / exchange API prices as corroboration
rejections.reason: Non-primary sources; using them would import an unexamined second oracle to judge the first.

rejections.rejected: Etherscan address labels and verified-contract badges as identity evidence
rejections.reason: Third-party platform metadata; identity is pinned by docs registry + chain readback agreement only.

rejections.rejected: Any wording implying CSOAI-Chainlink integration, partnership, endorsement, or canonical-oracle status
rejections.reason: No external confirmation exists; Goal 2 acceptance forbids the claim without it.

rejections.rejected: Any certification, grade, rating, or compliance wording for these artifacts
rejections.reason: Measurement credentials only; this pack stops at CANDIDATE_UNMEASURED.

rejections.rejected: Re-collecting LINK token contract identity in this pack
rejections.reason: Already a frozen subject in measurement/registers/2026-09-19 (token:link, sha256-pinned eth_getCode); this pack cites that register instead of duplicating it.

stale_evidence_policy: Every claim row carries retrieved_at; on-chain rows are valid only for their read time. Re-runs supersede by appending, never by editing frozen rows.
